offering_description.value: Owns and operates a fleet of dry bulk vessels that carry iron ore, coal, grain, bauxite and other commodities for charterers worldwide. Earns revenue by chartering ships on spot, time-charter and contract-of-affreightment terms. Ships are built by shipyards, and the company manages them through in-house technical management.

primary_services.value: ocean dry bulk cargo transportation; vessel time chartering; voyage chartering; ship technical and commercial management

customer_segment.value: B2B: commodity traders, miners, steel mills, grain merchants, and energy and industrial companies chartering vessels

end_markets.value: mining; steel; energy and coal; agriculture and grain; construction materials

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: time charter hire for vessels chartered for set periods; service fees: voyage charter freight for spot cargo transport

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and operates dry bulk vessels bought from shipyards, chartered to commodity shippers and traders

geography_served.value: global: worldwide seaborne trade routes, with operations managed from Greece and offices in Europe, the US and Asia

specialization.value: niche specialist: dry bulk shipping across Capesize, Panamax, Ultramax and Supramax vessel classes

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct charter contracts with charterers; agents / brokers: shipbrokers arranging charter fixtures

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: maritime safety and emissions rules from IMO, flag states and classification societies, sanctions and port state controls

notes: Fleet size and class mix may have changed. Company size is based on being one of the largest listed dry bulk owners.
